UIIC Administrative Officers AO Online Form 2026 – Full Details

United India Insurance Company Limited (UIIC) has released a Notifications for the post of Administrative Officers (AO) Scale-I (Generalist and Hindi Officer). This recruitment has been issued for 225 posts. Applications for UIIC Administrative Officers AO Recruitment 2026 will Start from 08 september 2026 & Candidate can apply till 28 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UIIC Administrative Officers AO Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 08 September 2026
  • Last Date : 28 September 2026
  • Last Date of Fee Payment : 28 September 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : 22 October 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 30 November 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC / ST / PH : Rs. 250/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
